_doc: Maps tab globe (docs/MENU_GLOBE.md). A region is the admin layer the camera dives into on the way to a map: its country (dimmed less than the rest of the world), its unit (state / judet: hatched, outlined, named) and the camera legs (overview of the whole country layer, the unit, then the city). Radii are the globe's radius in pixels at a 900 px tall screen (they scale with the screen height); detail_from: the radius the detail layer (counties / communes) is fully in by (none: with the admin layer). detail: the areas the build tool (tools/globe/build_globe.py) renders deeper than the world levels, from Sentinel-2 imagery and a 30 m height map: bbox [west, south, east, north] in degrees, level = the deepest tile level (10 = about 38 m per texel). Maps point at a region with their "globe" block (assets/maps/*.json).
